spec: world/crowd-sim.md is canonical prose; this file is the machine contract for the two-layer crowd. Named ambients resolve from ambients.json routines; extras are unnamed non-persistent background pawns (budgets below). v29 adds day shades, the flow layer, micro-texture, continuity rules, the appearance palette, and the greeting matrix. Conditions only — nothing here orders a pawn to do anything. v43 adds the ambient work zones (school/sfgeneral/folsom/auerbach/needlepointe/doloresperk — where the named layer actually spends its days) and ambient_resources — claimable sub-venue slots a request can book without locking the venue. v57 adds the shoulder conditions: the marine layer (fog as a depth profile with a burn-off hour and an all-day mode), afternoon wind, and season shades — the climate baseline the day shades and weather ride on. v71 adds the civic year (annual_shades — calendar-window budget conditions: Carnaval, game days, Día de los Muertos, the holiday lull) and the posture palette — the honest idle/dwell vocabulary extras and idle ambients hold (the content-side answer to 'Resting peacefully'). v85 adds the company layer (group_profile — extras spawn as lone/duo/cluster social units with family-shape safeguards, never solo particles) and the counter courtesies (named ambient ↔ anonymous extra pose exchanges — the greeting matrix's downstairs neighbor). v99 adds the bench layer — the pull protocol (how a request borrows a named ambient: window, capacity, bounds, minors never, in-role only) and the coverage map (what each ambient's post reads while borrowed — understudy extra, back-in-10 sign, or an honestly empty bench). v113 adds the mouths & pulses layer — mouths (the eight named spawn/despawn anchors that replace the bare 'edge': transit stairs, bus stops, the school gate, the garage ramp, the pickup curb, the stoops, the west edge), pulse_clocks (seven discrete arrival/departure lifts — train discharge, bus arrival, school bells, shift change, kitchen close, last call), and the leash (entry intents through/errand/dwell/cover plus per-mouth body conservation — the day is a closed loop).

conventions.hours: game-local decimal; dayparts are half-open [h0,h1) wrapping at 24
conventions.budget: extras headcount range [lo,hi] the spawner maintains per zone, off-camera only
conventions.ambients: world/ambients.json — A01..A20, thin AI, routines + reflexes
conventions.extras: no identity/state/ledger/feed name; reflexes limited to yield|queue|shelter|rubberneck
conventions.ambient_resources: claimable sub-venue resources (v43) — a request claims the resource, not the venue; extras budget inside the resource radius → 0 for the window, staff ambient stays on routine
conventions.work_zones: v43 zones for ambient workplaces; small budgets — most of the crowd inside is staff, not extras
conventions.annual_shades: v71 calendar-window layer — resolves season → annual (suppresses day shades when active) → weather
conventions.posture_palette: v71 dwell vocabulary — extras and idle ambients hold labeled postures instead of freezing; honest labels map is the content fix for idle-label lies
conventions.group_profile: v85 company layer — extras spawn in social units (lone/duo/cluster), resolved as normalize(kind_mix × daypart_mix); a unit is one spawn, one edge, one despawn; budgets still count bodies
conventions.courtesies: v85 counter-courtesy layer — named ambient ↔ anonymous extra pose exchanges gated on resolved state + extra presence + cooldown; gesture only, no dialogue, no ledger
conventions.pull_protocol: v99 — the rules for borrowing a named ambient as a co-star; conditions on resolved state + request class, never a dispatch
conventions.coverage: v99 — per-ambient absence surface while pulled: kind understudy|sign|open|pack; the post never lies (a tarped stand reads tarped, never 'serving')
conventions.mouths: v113 — named spawn/despawn anchors; every extra enters/leaves through a live mouth, off-camera by position; a mouth is a point with a direction and a per-minute cap, never a zone
conventions.pulse_clocks: v113 — named discrete lifts on a mouth's flow (train/bus cadence, school bells, shift change, kitchen close, last call); budget arithmetic at the doorway, never a dispatch; internal vocabulary
conventions.leash: v113 — entry intents (through/errand/dwell/cover) fix a unit's zone set and dwell window at spawn; despawn only at a mouth; per-mouth rolling-60min conservation keeps the day a closed loop
conventions.vacancies: v127 — permanent absences left by promotion: a promoted ambient's post is vacated, never covered; the venue keeps the function and loses the signature; no new regular is spawned to fill it (promotion.md is the only path to a named face)
conventions.occasions: v127 — bounded opportunities as crowd conditions (the population-model half of drama.json bounded_opportunities): a live public invitation modestly lifts its venue's extras budget and leaves a next-daypart trace; extras orbit, never attend; the named layer answers by routine, never by dispatch

fog_model.reflexes: no new reflex — fog is not wet, so shelter never fires; gaits unchanged. Fog is a gray read, not an empty one

season_shades.rule: climate baseline — resolved BEFORE day shades and weather, stacks with both (a shade is a day, a season is the month it lands in). Calendar-keyed by month; budget arithmetic only — no ambient routine changes

appearance_palette.rule: extraLook(day, zone, spawnIndex) — deterministic hash pick; variety without identity; reused under walk-chain windows
appearance_palette.note: 29 silhouettes × 6 gaits; palette tints hashed per spawn — the same corner never casts the same crowd twice, the same extra never casts a face. v71 adds calendar telltales (jersey-cap, marigold-bag, folding-chair, umbrella-up) — a silhouette can hint the date, never a name. v85 adds kid-backpack — kid-scale vocabulary that exists only inside family clusters under group_profile.shapes.family; it can never spawn lone, pair with a lone adult, or enter a bar or the overnight/night dayparts.

greeting_matrix.rule: familiarity weights between named ambients (mains noted where a routine crosses); a 'hi' weight = likely ≤15 s visual beat on same-zone collision, gated on greetable states; never moves a routine; observable-safe — no seed content; minors greet in public groups only; v127: pairs may name a supporting resident (S-id, flagged resident:true) — the ambient greets a person by their own choice of presence, never a dispatched pawn

boundaries.overnight_honesty: allow_deserted is protected — no system pads 00–04 to look alive
boundaries.scripts: budgets and conditions only; no pawn is ever told where a scene should happen
boundaries.resources: a resource claim never touches the staff ambient's routine and never turns an ambient into a protagonist; minors have no claimable resources
boundaries.weather_vocab: fog/wind/season ids are internal vocabulary — the wire still says band words and scene labels; a spectator sees a gray morning, never 'fog_season'
boundaries.civic_vocab: annual shade ids and posture ids are internal vocabulary — the wire still says band words and scene labels; a spectator sees jerseys and marigolds, never 'muertos'
boundaries.postures: postures are dwell conditions, not scripts — nobody is dispatched into one; minors never pair-posture outside the pack
boundaries.groups: a unit is costume cohesion, not identity — duos/clusters share a spawn, an edge, and a despawn, then stop existing together; kid-scale silhouettes exist only inside family clusters with an adult anchor, never lone, never in bars or overnight
boundaries.courtesies: a courtesy beat can render only while its conditions obtain — it is never dispatched; it carries gesture vocabulary only (no dialogue), the extra stays anonymous and ledgerless, and minors have no counter — June and Zee appear in no beat

ambient_resources.rule: sub-venue resources a player request can claim for a declared window without locking the venue (design §11 compatible/exclusive classes still apply — a resource claim is an exclusive-class request on the resource, human-reviewed like any exclusive). The claim zeros the extras budget inside the resource radius for the window; the staff ambient keeps their routine — the venue works, the people stay background. Minors never staff or neighbor a claimable resource.

annual_shades.rule: named calendar-window conditions resolved AFTER season shades and BEFORE day shades; when an annual shade matches, the day_shades layer is suppressed for that day (the holiday owns the day) — weather still stacks on top. Evaluation: all clauses in a window must match (months/dom/dow/nth = nth occurrence of dow in month); 'windows' lists alternatives (first hit wins). Budget arithmetic only — no routine is ever changed, no pawn is summoned. Ids are internal vocabulary — the wire still says band words and scene labels.
annual_shades.windows_schema: {months:[1-12], dom:[lo,hi] inclusive day-of-month, dow:[mon..sun], nth:int} — omit any clause to match all; nth requires dow

posture_palette.rule: dwell vocabulary for anything standing still: extras inside a zone budget who are not in transit or queue hold one posture and rotate on a dwell timer; named ambients whose resolved row is idle/sit/rest in a public zone cycle the same palette — the thin tier renders a small human behavior instead of freezing. Postures are conditions on (zone kind, pair availability), never scripts; nothing is dispatched to fill one. Minors pair only within the pack — a lone minor posture is always solo.

posture_palette.ambient_idle: when a named ambient's resolved state is idle/sit/rest in a public zone, the renderer picks a legal posture by hash(id, daypart, zone) — honest label from labels[]; never inside 'home', never while sleeping

group_profile.rule: extras spawn in social units, not as lone particles — a real sidewalk is about a third accompanied. A unit is {size, shape, gait, intent}: one spawn, one edge entry, one despawn; it never splits mid-frame and never merges with another unit. Zone budgets still count bodies (a cluster is 3–4 bodies toward the band); the ≤3-interactive-pawns cap counts the unit once. Units are as anonymous as lone extras — same off-camera lifecycle, same exclusions, no feed read.
group_profile.resolution: mix(zone, daypart) = normalize(kind_mix[kind] * daypart_mix[daypart]) — element-wise product, renormalized; a zero row falls back to the kind row alone

shapes.family: cluster units only; requires ≥1 adult-anchor silhouette plus a stroller or kid-backpack silhouette; zone kinds open_air/shop/cafe/civic/stand/restaurant only — never bar; never overnight or night; kid-scale silhouettes never appear lone and never pair with a lone adult unit

group_profile.note: duos walk abreast and read as 'together' — the linked-elbows pair, the stroller pushed two-handed. A unit that walks a chain keeps its shape; despawn takes the whole unit at once. A silhouette may hint a family, never a name.

courtesies.rule: the greeting matrix's downstairs neighbor — named ambient ↔ anonymous extra pose exchanges. A beat is a condition, not a dispatch: it can render only while the ambient's resolved row sits in a listed state, ≥1 extra dwells within arm's reach in the zone, and the cooldown since that ambient's last beat has elapsed. Gesture vocabulary only — 2–6 s, zero dialogue, zero ledger; the extra stays an extra (no handle, no name, no memory). Beats are suppressed automatically wherever a claim or lock zeroes the extras budget, and a beat counts as one interactive pawn toward the ≤3 cap. Minors have no counter — June and Zee appear in no beat.

shared.cap: counts as one interactive pawn toward the ≤3 rule

courtesies.retired: v127: ctr-section / ctr-stool / ctr-flash retired with promotion — a resident's gestures are brain-authored, never canned beats; their counters don't get replacement choreography

pull_protocol.bounds: the pull borrows presence inside the ambient's resolved routine — it may move them at most one zone step and only toward a zone the request already controls (a claimed resource or a locked venue); never relocates across the map, never into 'home'
pull_protocol.states: pullable only while the resolved row is a public or staffed state (serve/work/idle/sit/rest/chat/walk) — never from sleep, never from 'home', never mid-transit on a flow edge
pull_protocol.minors: A04 and A20 are never pullable — a request naming them resolves as a decline; their rows never enter the pool
pull_protocol.role_bound: the pull asks the role, not the person — Reyes can be borrowed as 'a barista at the counter', never as 'Reyes running an errand'; the ambient stays in-role per ambients.md co-star rules
pull_protocol.feed: pulls are invisible on the wire — no event type, no attribution; spectators see the coverage read, not the loan
pull_protocol.pipeline: a pull enters the §11 request pipeline at the same step as a resource claim; exclusive-class only when the ask needs sole attention
pull_protocol.residents: promoted residents (S-ids) are never pullable — the bench borrows schedules, not people; a request about a resident travels as a nudge through the ordinary §11 pipeline and may be declined

occasions.doc: crowd-sim §34 — the population-model half of drama.json bounded_opportunities: a live public invitation deforms the extras budget the way weather does. Uptake belongs to characters; the crowd only makes the room plausible.
rules: budget arithmetic only — an occasion lifts a venue's extras budget modestly (≤1.4) inside its window; it never dispatches a body, a pawn, or a person
extras orbit, never attend — no leash intent becomes 'participant'; an extra may dwell near an occasion, it may not join it
the named layer answers by routine — a main, resident, or ambient's presence at an occasion is their own; the crowd model never marks attendance
a pulse is never manufactured for an occasion — mouths and pulse clocks keep their schedules; occasions draw from existing traffic like a shade does
the trace is a read, not a residue — the next daypart may carry the aftermath detail (stacked chairs, taped edges); it never scores uptake and never names who came
sponsored invitations enter identically — a request-created occasion gets the same modesty cap and the same silence on the wire as an organic one
